seoTitle: DOOH Digital Billboard Advertising Guide for Local Business
description: A practical guide to DOOH advertising for local businesses: digital billboards, programmatic buying, event timing and niche guides for salons, cafes and gyms.
intro: This guide covers digital out-of-home advertising, meaning ads on digital billboards and screens, for local businesses. It includes how programmatic buying works, platform explainers, event-timed campaigns and guides for restaurants, coffee shops, salons, barbershops, gyms, yoga studios and pet groomers. It is for owners curious about reaching people near their location.

If your budget is limited, read the programmatic overview first to understand how small campaigns are bought, then the guide for your type of business. Plan a short test around a small area near your location, with a clear offer, and decide beforehand how you will tell whether it worked.

DOOH is harder to do alone than search or social, because screen selection, targeting and measurement all take experience. You can still run a small test through a self-serve platform if you are comfortable learning as you go. If not, DataLatte can help you decide whether it is worth trying at all.

faq.a: Digital out-of-home advertising shows ads on digital screens in public places, such as roadside billboards, transit and venues. Programmatic platforms let advertisers buy them by location and time instead of long contracts. That is what makes it possible for smaller businesses.

faq.q: How much does DOOH advertising cost?
faq.a: Prices vary by screen type, location and time of year, and platforms set their own minimums. Check current pricing with a provider before planning. Our guides explain what affects cost without quoting fixed numbers.

faq.q: Can a small business really use digital billboards?
faq.a: Often yes, through programmatic or self-serve platforms that sell short, targeted campaigns. It is still an awareness channel, so results can be harder to track than clicks. A small test is wiser than a big commitment.

faq.q: How do I measure whether DOOH worked?
faq.a: Look at signals you can connect to the campaign period, such as walk-ins, calls, branded searches or a redeemed offer code. It is rarely as exact as online ads. Decide on your measures before the campaign starts.
